title: NTE Host-Engine IPC Error Catalog Specification
description: Standardized categorized error codes, severities, and fail-closed recovery policies across the Native Host and Python Intelligence Engine boundary.

errors.description: Host and Engine negotiate incompatible protocol versions (exact match '1.0.0' required).
Received a messageType string not present in message_catalog_v1.json.
JSON message envelope is missing required fields or has invalid field types (coercion prohibited).
Received message sequence number is less than or equal to previous high-water mark for sender in current session.
Message sessionId does not match current active negotiated session.
Attempted illegal state machine transition (e.g. HANDSHAKING -> READY on reconnect without SYNCING).
Duplicate command received while original command is still executing.
Re-submitted command with identical commandId but conflicting action or parameters.
Named Pipe peer closed handle or crashed unexpectedly.
IO exception occurred during pipe read or write operation (ERROR_BROKEN_PIPE 109).
Frame length prefix exceeds maxMessageBytes (1048576 bytes / 1 MB).
Unexpected end of stream encountered before reading declared length prefix.
Transport stream buffer contains fewer bytes than indicated by the 4-byte length prefix.
Message payload schema does not match declared schema in message catalog.
Message payload lacks one of requiredPayloadFields defined in message catalog.
Shared memory frame header magic does not equal 0x4246544E ('NTFB').
Frame buffer slice is smaller than 64-byte FrameHeaderV1.
Frame corner pixel checksum does not match expected header cornerChecksum.
FRAME_READY envelope metadata contradicts actual shared memory FrameHeaderV1 values.
bufferIndex is outside the negotiated range 0 <= bufferIndex < slotCount.
FRAME_ACK received for a slot that is not currently locked or in use by consumer.
FRAME_ACK received with sequence number not matching the active frame in the slot.
Shared memory pixelFormat != 1 (BGRA8).
Engine did not reply with HELLO_ACK within helloNegotiationTimeoutMs (5000ms).
No HEARTBEAT message received within heartbeatTimeoutMs (3000ms).
Engine did not release slot within frameAckTimeoutMs (500ms). Slot remains locked without forced overwrite.
Engine did not complete COMMAND before expiresAtNs or commandExecutionTimeoutMs.
Host attempted to assert business truth, or Engine attempted direct OS window/input manipulation.
Host UI attempted to mutate CurrentMatch state directly without Python COMMAND roundtrip.
Action requested a capability marked UNAVAILABLE during handshake negotiation.
Attempted to activate Windows.Graphics.Capture which is strictly NOT_MEASURED in production.
CoreWebView2Controller failed to attach to host HWND visual tree.
